title: A flat family over an integral base with integral generic fibre is integral
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a flat morphism f : X -> Y with Y integral and the generic fibre of f integral, the total space X is integral (source lines 1734-1738). The proof states the algebraic analogue - a flat algebra B over a domain A whose base change to the fraction field is a domain is itself a domain - and proves it in one line: B is torsion free over the domain A, hence injects into B (x)_A K, a subring of a domain.
